texts.text:
ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the
B2-2, Neighborhood Mixed-Use Districts and C1-3 Neighborhood Commercial
Districts and indications as shown on Map No. 7-J in the area bound by:

      The alley next northwest and parallel to North Allen Avenue; the alley next
      northeast of and parallel to North Milwaukee Avenue; North Allen Avenue; and
      North Milwaukee Avenue,

to those of a B3-1, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                    __________________________
                                                    Carlos Ramirez-Rosa
                                                    Alderman, 35th Ward




Common Address:
2901-2909 N Milwaukee Avenue
